01 / Field notes

Nothing stays
in balance for long.

Every ball has a mass. Columns stand in pairs on four scales, and the heavier side sinks. Line up three or more of one colour in a row and they dissolve. Stack five of a colour in a column and they fuse into one heavy ball. Let a stack cross the carriage line, and the experiment is over.

03 / Specials

Twenty ways
to break the rules.

Bombs, jokers, stars, zaps and tints. New kinds appear as you level up, and each one changes the board in its own way.

  • BombBlows up balls in a 3×3 square
  • JokerBecomes a ball of any colour
  • Silver starThree in a row clear the field
  • CutterClears its whole column
  • HeartThree in a row score a bonus
  • Colour zapClears the colour it lands on
  • Diagonal zapClears both diagonals
  • Tint 3×3Repaints the 3×3 square around it

Some special balls are gifts along the way. Extra packs are optional in-app purchases.
